cohort: 161 pregnant women who attended Private Lokman Hekim Hospital for follow-up between February 2021 and August 2021.
finding: Neonatal biacromial and bideltoid diameters were significantly correlated with shoulder dystocia and macrosomia.
mod_finding: A bideltoid diameter of ≥21 cm had 100% sensitivity and 90.63% specificity for predicting shoulder dystocia.
followup_time: Within the first two hours after birth
